font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: Grey dashed line, criterion 0.30. Fiducial-point values (database-supplied; dotted) are from noise-free beats,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: so the noise columns are not a like-for-like comparison (its tier-B value moves with noise only because the

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: common subset changes). Numbers in the tier-A panels, pass rate (remaining in tier A) at noise 0 / 1 / 2 %.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: Tier A, subjects accepted by the method itself; tier B, subjects accepted by every compared method; tier C, all

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222
font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: Tier B, 732 subjects (388 at 1 %, 323 at 2 %): the intersection of the subjects accepted by all three fits, a

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: subset favourable to the decomposition. Tier C, 3,378 type-3 subjects. Table 6c of 02_tables.md.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: Exploratory, post hoc analysis; not used for the prespecified decision. Using an improved fit as a primary

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'Liberation Sans', 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #222222

g.text: analysis would require a new preregistration.
